theorem_title: Corollary 4.9 central-arc mass for the Section 8 cutoff
formal_statement:
namespace TaoFivePrimes

theorem S1_major_arc_L2_mass_corollary49_limit (x : ℕ)
    (h1 : 87 * 10 ^ 35 ≤ x) :
    0.94 * (∫ t : ℝ, eta1 t ^ 2) * x ≤
      ∫ α in majorArc x, ‖S1 x α‖ ^ 2 ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
  sorry

end TaoFivePrimes
natural_language_statement:
Let $x \ge 8.7\times 10^{36}$. For Tao's Section 8 trapezoidal cutoff $\eta_1$ and sifted prime exponential sum $S_1$, the $L^2$ mass on the strongly major arc satisfies

$$0.94\,\|\eta_1\|_2^2 x \le \int_{\|\alpha\|\le T_0/(3.6\pi x)} |S_1(x,\alpha)|^2\,d\alpha.$$

This is the scale-invariant specialization of Corollary 4.9. The literal Lipschitz cutoff is obtained from the smooth statement by the infinitesimal mollification and limiting convention used in Section 8.
source: Terence Tao, Every odd number greater than 1 is the sum of at most five primes, arXiv:1201.6656v4, Corollary 4.9 (equation 4.14) and Section 8 (equations 8.2-8.9), https://arxiv.org/html/1201.6656v4
